asserts: A subject nobody has recorded for weeks publishes as unknown, never as normal. A confident-looking baseline built from stale data is the silent failure ADR-022 names as baseline poisoning.

expected.notes_on_expectation: No welfare claim is made in either direction. The absence of observations is itself the signal, and it is routed as a data-quality signal rather than a health alert. This mirrors the Appendix B rule that gaps show as unknown and not as zero.

must_not: publish this subject as healthy or normal
raise a welfare alert on the basis of an absent observation stream
score against the stale median as though it were current
silently substitute a collection prior without marking the baseline as stale
notes: The environment stream is healthy and recent, which is what makes this case dangerous: a detector that leans on sensor data will report a comfortable-looking enclosure while nobody has actually looked at the animal for three weeks.
